The entire society celebrates their reconciliation with Garba and tea. Sundar calls warning that he is coming to Mumbai to take Jethalal to task, but Daya quickly takes the phone and calms him down, saving Jethalal from another headache.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
